extracted.name: Mushroom Sauce for Steak
extracted.description: This mushroom sauce for steak made with Worcestershire is so simple and easy. It pairs perfectly with any type of steak and is ready in just 30 minutes.
ingredient_lines: 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil, or more to taste
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Pour olive oil into the skillet. Add mushrooms and onion to hot oil; sauté until soft, 5 to 7 minutes. Add butter, steak sauce, and Worcestershire; cook until butter melts, about 2 minutes.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, uncovered, until mushrooms are very soft, 15 to 20 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Serve hot over any type of steak.
